notes.title: 致各位关心《李二牛勇闯合欢宗》的玩家：关于六月新品节的重要通知与道歉
notes.notes:
[p][b]Dear Fellow Players,​[/b]​[/p][p]It is with deep regret that we announce: ​[b]​The demo version of [i]Li Erniu's Journey to Huanzong Sect[/i] will be unable to participate in the upcoming June Steam Next Fest as planned.​[/b]​[/p][p]🛑 ​[b]​Brief Explanation:​[/b]​
Despite our team's dedicated efforts to prepare the demo and timely submission of all required materials, the platform's review process took longer than anticipated, preventing final approval before the event start date. This situation was entirely beyond our control, and we sincerely apologize for the disappointment.[/p][p]💡 ​[b]​Keeping Our Promise! Immediate Action – Limited Closed Beta Launch!​[/b]​
We know we promised player feedback in June, and we refuse to let you wait in vain! To compensate for our absence from the event and to gather your invaluable input on schedule, we have decided:
👉 ​[b]​A limited-time, limited-access closed beta test for the [i]Li Erniu's Journey to Huanzong Sect[/i] demo starts NOW!​[/b]​[/p][p]​[b]​How to Participate?​[/b]​
We will announce detailed application methods, timing, and participant quotas via ​[b]​Steam Community Announcements​[/b]​, ​[b]​Bilibili​[/b]​, and other platforms shortly. (Please allow us a brief period to finalize the test build on Steam.)[/p][p]🔔 ​[b]​Crucial Step:​[/b]​
​[b]​\[Wishlist the game / Follow our Steam Community Hub]​[/b]​ to ensure you receive immediate notifications about the beta launch and don’t miss your chance to apply![/p][p]🔮 ​[b]​The Road Ahead: This Autumn, We Shall Meet!​[/b]​
We have immediately applied for and confirmed that the [i]Li Erniu's Journey to Huanzong Sect[/i] demo ​[b]​will participate in the Steam Next Fest from October 16th to 22nd, 2024!​[/b]​
We will arrive on time with a meticulously refined demo version to meet all players.[/p][p]🙏 ​[b]​Our Message to You:​[/b]​
This setback disappoints and saddens us as much as it does you. ​[b]​From the bottom of our hearts: We are truly sorry!​[/b]​ But please know our team remains fully committed to developing the game. Your support and encouragement fuel our determination every day.[/p][p]✅ ​[b]​While Awaiting October's Next Fest, You Can:​[/b]​
👉 ​[b]​Be an Early Tester!​[/b]​ Apply for the closed beta (details coming soon). Your feedback is vital!
👉 ​[b]​Share Your Hopes!​[/b]​ Comment below: What gameplay or content are you most eager to experience in the ​[b]​official October demo​[/b]​?
👉 ​[b]​\[Add to Wishlist](Steam Store Link):​[/b]​ Get instant updates on development, beta news, and the October Next Fest![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3449830/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Every comment, every show of support, propels us forward. This October, we [i]will[/i] keep our promise with a significantly improved demo shaped by your invaluable input![/p][p]Once again, thank you for your understanding, patience, and unwavering support.[/p][p]​[b]​Warmly,​[/b]​
​[b]​\[[/b]优忧子开发团队[b]]​[/b][/p]
